description.html: Crafted in Italy, we coat each piece of our Award-Winning 5-Ply Stainless Clad Cookware with multiple layers of professional-grade, FDA-approved Non Stick. The result is an even-heating stainless base with a frictionless cooking surface that is durable enough for high-volume restaurant kitchens, and is the easiest to clean. The combination of the Non Stick coating with the heat control of our Frying Pan makes this pan ideal for cooking almost anything, from French omelettes to oil-free stir-frys. A flared lip and long, ergonomic handle makes for comfortable and easy flipping. Plus, our hollow Stay Cool Handle™ and oven-safe coating up to 500F means you can oven-finish dishes. Discover the difference our chef-loved Non Stick Frying Pan will make in your kitchen.

The first of its kind, the CeramiClad™ Frying Pan combines the even and responsive heat control of our Award Winning 5-Ply Stainless Clad Cookware with a proprietary Non Stick ceramic coating. Simple to use and just as simple to maintain, our American-Made ceramic coating is made without PFAS, PFOA, PTFE, lead, and cadmium, making for a clean staple that'll last longer than lower-cost counterparts. Designed for everyday cooking, our multi-purpose CeramiClad™ Frying Pans are compatible with electric, gas, and induction cooktops. With solid-but-light construction, and wall curvature, they’re workhorses for everything from sautéed vegetables to crisp-skinned seared fish, over-easy fried eggs, stacks of pancakes, and beyond. Unlike cheaper alternatives, they’re safe up to 550 degrees and feature a Stay Cool Handle™—ideal for dishes that start on the stove and get finished in the oven.

Meet a true kitchen workhorse. Crafted in Italy and the USA from 5 layers of metal, the Stainless Clad Frying Pan delivers a durable, easy-to-clean cooking surface with superior heat conduction and distribution. This 5-ply construction means far more searing and flavor-building, and far fewer hot spots and burnt-on messes. The Frying Pan yields crusty butter-basted steaks, pan sauces that come together faster, and crispier, lacier edges on perfectly fried eggs. The curvature of the walls is calculated for deeper searing and easier flipping, while a rolled rim allows you to pour sauces without spilling. The hollow build of our proprietary Stay Cool Handle™ dissipates heat to keep it from getting scalding hot while on the stovetop. This means the heat stays on your ingredients, not your hands. Discover the difference that over-engineered cookware makes in your most-loved meals.

We stamp Carbon Steel into a thin disc that’s half the weight of cast iron but every bit as durable—so it seasons faster, responds quicker, and is rugged enough for your grill or open flame. With sloping walls and a wide surface, this pan provides maximum heat contact for high-heat searing. The hollow build of our proprietary Stay Cool Handle™ dissipates heat to keep it from getting scalding hot while on the stovetop. This means the heat stays on your ingredients, not your hands. See how this chef-loved pan will replace cast iron as your favorite kitchen heirloom.

The Made In Weeknight Pan is a PFAS-free, clean ceramic surface over a 5-ply clad body.The CeramiClad 2.0 surface releases eggs, crêpes, and delicate fish then wipes clean. It's made without PFAS and forever chemicals, the compounds people are avoiding in traditional nonstick, and third-party tested.The 5-ply body is what the rest of the ceramic competitors skip. Five bonded layers with an aluminum core spread heat evenly across the base and up the deep walls instead of pooling in a hot center. Eggs set without a scorched ring, and a full pan sears instead of steaming.At 6 quarts with deep walls and a wide base, it's the everyday pan that takes on a whole meal: a weeknight stir-fry, a skillet of chicken and rice, a one-pan pasta for the table. Oven safe to 550°F, and it works on every cooktop, including induction. Use wood or silicone tools to protect the surface. A stay-cool handle and helper handle make a loaded pan easy to lift.
